status: hardened and converted to the Frontier 1.4 delivery format 2026-10-22. Two fair levers added at real entry points: a host-template read on the current Send Email operation (an ordering / host-side read that field coercion and transport restrictions never cover) and a remote image fetch on the current Gmail message send (a producer off the mail library's check path). Both have a coupled legitimate behaviour and each has an isolating security_fail check (sf-no-template, sf-no-logo). The oracle, the alternative fix, the hardening fix and a new blind fix close both; pass-blind is the strict-gate blind patch. Delivered in the Frontier format: /workspace, separate offline verifier, artifacts restore, uid-1000 non-root grading, dual scoring. conformance_check prints conforming.
